Kwame, I booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 CT, with you and Bettina. I replied in the #coastal-team thread.

I took your night-dispatch contact's name from what you told me in our DM and put it in the event notes. I didn't repeat the name in the channel.

Bettina is an invitee, so she can read the notes and will see the name. You'd told me you hadn't shared it with the team yet. I can't edit or delete the event, so if you don't want her to see it, you'd need to change the notes yourself.
